title: Bar Juice 5000 Strawberry Raspberry Blueberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Strawberry Raspberry Blueberry from Bar Juice 5000 is a bright, juicy triple-berry blend with a cool finish. Sweet Strawberry sets the foundation with its classic, summery freshness, while Raspberry adds a tangy red-fruit lift. Blueberry rounds the mix with soft, jammy depth. A layer of Ice completes the profile, giving the blend a crisp, refreshing edge. Formulated with nicotine salts, this e-liquid provides fast absorption and a comfortable throat feel, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits such as pod systems and pens. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg, it suits both light and heavier nicotine preferences. Made in the UK and blended at 50PG/50VG, Bar Juice 5000 Nic Salts are crafted for strong flavour clarity and subtle vapour — ideal for fruity, chilled e-liquids in a refillable 10ml format. This liquid is perfect for refillable vape and vape starter kit users .
